info.title: flagship admin API
info.description: Manage projects, flags, segments, change requests, experiments and webhooks. Authenticate with an API token (Authorization: Bearer fst_...) or a session cookie plus its CSRF token on state-changing requests. Errors share one body: {"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}.
